'''Nahrung''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he and several other soldiers were called to [[Sebaddon]] to eliminate an army of hex droids that planned to to wipe out the entire galaxy. Just before takeoff, he was commissioned by Larin, to observe the orbital scans to detect the location of a central factory.
